dialect.detail: IBM Enterprise COBOL for z/OS with OO extensions (INVOKE, object references, REPOSITORY clause with Java class mappings); IMS MPP (Message Processing Program) using CBLTDLI; JNI interop via JNI copybook; CBL DLL,THREAD compiler options indicate z/OS DLL threading model
evidence: REPOSITORY clause with Java class mappings (com.ibm.jzos.ZUtil, java.lang.String, etc.)

purpose.domain_detail: IMS MPP (Message Processing Program) sample demonstrating COBOL-to-Java interoperability via JNI on z/OS
purpose.summary: This is an IBM sample IMS COBOL MPP program (IMSCBLJB) that reads input messages from the IMS message queue via CBLTDLI calls and invokes Java methods using OO COBOL extensions and JNI. It demonstrates three types of Java calls: a static void method (ZUtil.redirectStandardStreams), the Java main method (JavaSample.main), and a static method returning a String (JavaSample.getResponse), then returns the result as an IMS output message.

notable_features: OO COBOL INVOKE statements for Java interoperability
REPOSITORY clause mapping Java classes to COBOL class names
JNI direct calls (NewString, GetObjectClass, NewObjectArray, GetStringLength, GetStringChars, ReleaseStringChars, ExceptionOccurred, ExceptionClear)
COPY "JNI" SUPPRESS copybook for JNI interface
IMS CBLTDLI calls (GU, ISRT) with IO-PCB-MASK linkage
CBL DLL,THREAD compiler options for z/OS threading
PIC N (national) data items for Unicode string handling
FUNCTION DISPLAY-OF with CCSID 1140 for EBCDIC conversion
verdict.notes: This is an official IBM sample program (copyright IBM Corp. 2021, Apache License 2.0) demonstrating IMS COBOL-to-Java interoperability. The COPY IMSC2JC copybook (not shown) defines INPUT-MSG/OUTPUT-MSG structures. The JNI copybook is also not shown. Program is well-structured and production-quality despite being a sample/demo.
